notes.title: Patchnotes Release 1.6.0
notes.content:
Small but great update incoming!

There was a certain need for splitting up the manual and auto save game. Guess what happened?

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Add separate load submenu
[*] New submenu shows 2 savegames with the corresponding nick and timestamp
[/list]
While this is fully implemented for the pause menu already, the manual savegame is still loaded from the main menu initially. Feel free to use the pause menu load option right away then. In most of the cases the manual save should be the right one anyway, shouldn't it?

Happy saving! Not only for christmas!

tags.feature: New submenu shows 2 savegames with the corresponding nick and timestamp

notes.title: Patchnotes Release 1.5.0
notes.content:
Asked by you for a long time, finally delivered

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Start the game in resizeable windowed mode
[*] Add toggle to switch between window and fullscreen in main menu options
[/list]
You can now play in a small window beside your opened browser or discord, yeah! Works great!


[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fix wrong rain emitting in transition from graveyard bridge to castle
[*] Fix potential wrong binary path of linux client for some linux distributions
[/list]

All linux users can now enjoy their ride, finally.

Charging! Laser go brrrr!

Add toggle to switch between window and fullscreen in main menu options

notes.title: Patchnotes Release 1.4.0
notes.content:
What lasts long always becomes good! Finally, there's something like a quest tracker.

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Add quest tracker on the upper right, so that you're always aware, what the next steps are
[/list]
Still, it might make sense to listen to the NPCs during the dialogues, though.

[b]Changes/Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Change window management to exclusive fullscreen instead of borderless to improve performance
[*] Credit more sound creators in main menu
[*] Update versions in end credits
[/list]

Don't get lost, buddy!

tags.feature: Add quest tracker on the upper right, so that you're always aware, what the next steps are

notes.title: Patchnotes Release 1.3.0
notes.content:
Some bigger changes come with this update.

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Add hardmode option with increased stats, damage and reduced cooldowns for bosses
[*] Add permadeath option for a new game
[*] Add hardmode and permadeath to leaderboard overview
[/list]
You can reach the hardmode either via the leaderboard for boss retries or in the main menu for a new game.
Permadeath is only available for a new game, though.


[b]Changes/Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Increase cooldown (15->30) + mana cost (10->25) for Magic LaserBeam
[*] Auto equip tree branch in graveyard melee tutorial on pickup
[*] Make blacksmith outcome slot unavailable unless a recipe was crafted
[*] Make inventory menu closeable with inventory shortcut (I button) # only outside the tutorial
[*] Reduce stun duration of Ducks SqueakAttack (3->1s)
[*] Improve MagicLandMine handling
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Avoid moving vendor potions to hotbar directly
[*] Avoid losing vendor potions during drag and drop
[*] Fix damage calculation of Ducks picking attack
[*] Fix wrong damage calculation for MagicLandMine
[/list]
Give the LandMine a try, its much more worth it than before. Bada boom!


Good luck and have fun, fellows!

notes.title: 1.0.0 Release
notes.content:
I put some work into it for the release version, especially when it comes to bugfixing:
[list]
[*] Fixed possibility to cheat potions at the vendor
[*] Fixed item stacking vendor->inventory
[*] Fixed item stacking hotbar->inventory
[*] Fixed item stacking blacksmith->inventory
[*] Fixed broken invincibility for player and enemy
[*] Adjusted sound volume at various places
[/list]


I've tried to make the savegame migration from 0.1.4 to 1.0.0 as seamlessly as possible, so you should just get a new boss with a new ending added, assuming you've reached the Early Access End already. If not, Elder Cheeks should inform you about the allmighty final opponent.

Additions:
[list]
[*] New boss (The allmighty Wombat) with unique abilities
[*] Separate animations to introduce each ability
[*] New boss introduction
[*] New final boss theme
[*] New credits/outro
[/list]


I'm pretty proud, what I could achieve with this codebase, as the Wombat fight is the most structured one, imo. Enjoy your final!

This Wombat is for you, Arne <3
